title: Al-Wasi: The Divine Name That Answers the Fear There Will Not Be Enough
excerpt: Al-Wasi occurs nine times in the Quran, and every one of them lands right after somebody's calculation that there is not enough to go around — money, marriage, membership, even forgiveness.
seo_title: Al-Wasi: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Wasi appears 9 times in the Quran. Al-Jalalayn glosses it as the breadth of His bounty, and each occurrence answers a specific fear of scarcity.
